title: AM Intelligence Pursues $3B in Funding for Newest Nvidia AI Chips
summary:
The Indian infrastructure company is looking for financing to complete its order of high-end accelerators for artificial intelligence. AM Intelligence is attempting to raise as much as $3 billion to fund the purchase of the latest semiconductor systems from Nvidia, according to people familiar with the matter.

The funding would be used to acquire Vera Rubin systems, a next-generation line of chips that the firm had previously announced it intended to incorporate into its AI infrastructure operations.
